gen-gf-varta-fs-literata: Friendly curves with big entrances, Varta sets a soft, modern tone up top. Literata, a serif with wide-mouthed curves and sturdy thin lines, is where the bookish warmth really lives.
gen-gf-vibes-instrument-sans: Huddled and bold, Vibes packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere. Vibes earns its keep big and short, with Instrument Sans holding steady below.
gen-gf-vibes-poppins: Huddled letters, bold attitude: Vibes crowds its lowercase up toward the caps. Poppins, a sans with loose, unknotted curves and a sturdy tall body, gives that crowd room to breathe beside it.
gen-gf-ysabeau-sc-fs-literata: Open curves, modern and unfussy: Ysabeau SC keeps its line steady yet faintly modulated. Literata, a serif, adds slightly heavier thick strokes beneath, so the two trade quiet modulation for bookish warmth.
gen-gf-yuji-syuku-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional at heart, Yuji Syuku changes weight gradually, never with a snap. Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif, can run at a modest size, since generous gaps between its curve ends and stems stay open.
gen-gf-zcool-qingke-huangyou-fs-literata: Drafting-pen lines hold through every bend in ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou. Literata shows its modest contrast only up close, so it can be sized down without losing its sturdy thin lines.
gen-nosifer-poppins: Dark and commanding, Nosifer stretches wide, pinching its letter mouths tightly shut like a sealed envelope flap. Nosifer menaces; Poppins, a sans-serif, simply speaks clearly through loose, open curves.
gen-nosifer-rubik: Dark, wide-tracked and pinched shut, Nosifer means business. Rubik, soft with big lowercase and round open letters, is the reply, and that closed-versus-open split is what drives the pair.
gen-pirata-one-rubik: Gothic and commanding, Pirata One packs its letters nose to tail. Rubik, a sans-serif, feels soft and clean beside it, like an open window next to a stone gatehouse.
gen-titan-one-mulish: Towering midzone, playful brush-lifted curve ends: that is Titan One. Mulish, a sans with open horseshoe-like apertures and no thick-and-thin shift, brings approachable quiet to temper that loud heading.
